name: rea
description: Inspect shipped applications, binaries, packages, firmware, and runtime evidence with REA.

interface.longDescription: A local Codex integration for REA by morluto. Inspect native binaries, .NET assemblies, JavaScript and Electron apps, packages, firmware, and supported runtime evidence. Includes the upstream investigation skill and a version-pinned MCP server. Native analysis requires a compatible installed analysis engine.
defaultPrompt: Inspect this application and explain how its features work.
Compare these two releases and show the evidence for changes.
Analyze this binary and explain its important functions.
